title: RUNS-ON-IP-1: brand/shell public text must not state the criticality formula (blocks QNFO/qnfo-workers#11907)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** QNFO/qnfo-workers#11907 holds (HOLD comment 2026-11-14)
**Done check:** grep:brand/shell/artifact/ultrastable-shell.json::k_eff
**Status:** closed

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=brand/shell/src

QNFO/qnfo-workers#11907 vendors the runtime shell artifact into a public repository, and one tile definition describes in words how k_eff is computed. No patent is filed and none gates publication (2026-11-17); the shell's exported text names each tile and its good/warn/bad meaning only. Rebuild the artifact, refresh the content hash, then the QNFO side refreshes its vendored copy and releases the hold with a 'hold released' comment.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 157.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
